claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_temperature_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item prevents harm from a bounded environmental temperature condition, including protection for the wearer and carried/worn gear. That is neither damage resistance nor incoming-damage reduction, and no existing passive atom models environmental cold immunity.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower
